_about: Labelled cases for the personal-data detector (src/pii.py). All values are made up: published test card numbers, example.com/.org/.net addresses, 555-01xx phone numbers, and SSNs in ranges a reader can check. `expect` lists the kinds a careful human would mark, in order, including some the detector misses by design (marked `known_miss`), so the measurement reports them honestly.
